maker: NSAIT — Nairobi Space of AI Tools
direction: Light glassmorphic premium fintech — pearl-white canvas, deep-navy wordmark, cyan/mint glass orb, warm-gold accent. (Chosen 2026-06-30, supersedes the dark-teal v1.)

logo.concept: Luminous orbital core (listening intelligence) wrapped in soundwave rings (the spoken command) and a closed orbit (money settled).
logo.clear_space: height of the 'O' in the wordmark, all sides

rules.ongea_owns: cyan + mint glass on pearl-white, deep-navy wordmark, sparing warm-gold accent
rules.one_idea_per_logo: ONE central device (orb OR halo OR portal) + at most a waveform + 2 rings. Never stack currency particles + money paths + arrows + mic + waveform + 3 rings together — that is what causes mushy renders.
forbidden: more than one gold accent per mark
